title: What Does a Small Boat Feel Like If You Have Never Been on One?
description: Closer to the water than a ferry: a slow rocking when stopped, a firm, bouncy ride at speed, wind, engine noise and some spray. The back is steadiest.
heroAlt: View from the back of the boat over the white wake towards Funchal on a bright morning
keywords: what does a small boat feel like
first time on a small boat
small motor boat ride what to expect
best seat on a boat to avoid motion

images.prompt: Bright mid-morning just west of Funchal, Madeira. Seen from the back deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking back over the stern: a long white wake curving across deep blue water towards the Funchal hillside of white houses and the marina in the distance. In the lower corner, a passenger's hand rests on the boat rail, no face. A little spray in the air catches the light. Natural light, true colours.
images.alt: View from the back of the boat over the white wake towards Funchal on a bright morning

images.prompt: From the middle of a white motor boat under a dark canopy, looking forward: the bow lifting slightly over a small wave, a light curtain of spray to the side, the cliffs of the Madeira south coast ahead, sunny morning, no faces.
images.alt: Bow of the boat lifting over a small wave with spray and cliffs ahead

images.prompt: From the water at a swim stop: a white motor boat at rest with its engine off, rocking gently on a calm swell below tall dark cliffs near Fajã dos Padres, soft reflections, late morning light, a few small figures on deck.
images.alt: Boat resting with the engine off on a calm swell below tall cliffs
